title: This Mouse Escapes by Letting 60 Percent of Its Skin Rip Off
subject: African spiny mouse

scenes.text: A mouse that escapes by letting its own skin rip off.
African spiny mice can lose up to 60 percent of the skin on their backs when a predator grabs them.
Their skin is about 20 times weaker than a lab mouse's, and it tears with 77 times less energy.
That should be fatal. Instead, new skin covers the wound in about three days, while ordinary mice need five to seven.
They even regrow hair follicles and ear cartilage with hardly any scar.
Researchers study them hoping to learn how human skin might one day heal without scars.
